label: 2 Sunnah before Fajr
exp: Better than the world and all it contains.

label: Fajr prayer
exp: Foundation of the day; the angels of night and day witness it.

label: Morning adhkar
exp: Saying Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru... 3 times in the morning: no sudden affliction strikes until evening.

label: Istighfar (seek forgiveness)
exp: The Prophet ﷺ sought forgiveness more than 70 times daily.

label: Salawat upon the Prophet ﷺ
exp: One salawat brings ten blessings from Allah.

label: Duha prayer (2 or more rakahs)
exp: Two rakahs of Duha suffice for the charity due on every joint each morning.

label: 4 Sunnah before Dhuhr
exp: The Prophet ﷺ never missed four rakahs before Dhuhr.

label: Dhuhr prayer
exp: Midday obligation — establishes rhythm of worship.

label: 2 Sunnah after Dhuhr
exp: Twelve daily Sunnah rakahs earn a house in Jannah.

label: Asr prayer
exp: Guarding Asr is specifically emphasised.

label: Dua at iftar
exp: At iftar the Prophet ﷺ would say: "Thirst has gone, the veins are moist, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills."

label: Maghrib prayer
exp: The Prophet ﷺ prayed Maghrib when the sun had set.

label: 2 Sunnah after Maghrib
exp: Prayed regularly by the Prophet ﷺ.

label: Evening adhkar
exp: Saying Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru... 3 times in the evening: no sudden affliction strikes until morning.

label: Isha prayer
exp: Praying Isha and Fajr in congregation is like standing the whole night in prayer.

label: 2 Sunnah after Isha
exp: Two after Isha are among the twelve daily rakahs for which a house is built in Paradise.

label: Tarawih
exp: Whoever prays the nights of Ramadan with faith and hoping for reward has his past sins forgiven.

label: Witr prayer
exp: Make it your last prayer of the night.

label: Night adhkar before sleep
exp: Recite Ayat al-Kursi when you go to bed: a guard from Allah stays with you and no devil comes near you till morning.

label: Tahajjud (last third of night)
exp: Allah descends and asks: "Who calls upon Me that I may answer?"

label: Dua in last third of night
exp: In the last third of every night Allah offers to answer whoever calls, give whoever asks and forgive whoever seeks it.

label: Istighfar before sleep
exp: Whoever says Sayyid al-Istighfar at night with firm faith and dies before morning is of the people of Paradise.

label: Self-accountability (muhasaba)
exp: "Let every soul look to what it has sent forth for tomorrow."

label: Renewed intention for tomorrow
exp: The most beloved deeds to Allah are the most consistent.

label: Slept early for Fajr
exp: The Prophet ﷺ disliked sleeping before Isha and talking after it. Protect your Fajr.

label: Quran recitation (daily portion)
exp: Ramadan is the month of Quran — recite your daily pages.

label: Reflected on meaning (tadabbur)
exp: Pondering deeply transforms the heart and guides action.

label: Applied a lesson from today's reading
exp: Knowledge without action is incomplete.

label: Listened to Quran recitation
exp: Listen and be silent so that you may receive mercy.

label: Memorised new ayah(s)
exp: The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.

label: Renewed intention (ikhlas)
exp: Every action takes its value from the heart.

label: Checked and corrected riya
exp: Riya quietly voids reward.

label: Guarded the tongue
exp: Fasting disciplines speech as much as hunger.

label: Avoided arguments while fasting
exp: If insulted, say "I am fasting."

label: Lowered the gaze
exp: What the eyes consume shapes the heart.

label: Controlled anger
exp: The strong one controls himself when angry.

label: Chose gentleness in interactions
exp: Nothing is heavier on the Scale than good character.

label: Showed mercy to others
exp: The Merciful shows mercy to those who show mercy.

label: Practised humility
exp: Whoever humbles himself for Allah, Allah will raise him.

label: Forgave someone
exp: Whoever pardons and reconciles, his reward is with Allah.

label: Made dua for someone in their absence
exp: An angel says: "Amin, and for you the same."

label: Made someone happy for Allah's sake
exp: Do not belittle any good deed, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.

label: Gave charity (any amount)
exp: Charity does not decrease wealth.

label: Fed someone who was fasting
exp: You receive the same reward as the fasting person.

label: Served or helped parents/family
exp: After prayer on time, the deed most loved by Allah is kindness to parents.

label: Maintained ties of kinship
exp: Whoever maintains family ties, Allah maintains ties with him.

label: Visited or supported the sick
exp: Whoever visits a sick person remains in the harvest of Paradise until he returns.

label: Made dua for others privately
exp: An angel says: "Amin, and for you the same."

label: Sought Laylat al-Qadr tonight
exp: Better than 1,000 months. Strive every night.

label: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul 'afwa fa'fu 'anni
exp: The dua the Prophet ﷺ taught Aishah for Laylatul Qadr.

label: Extra Quran recitation
exp: Every night of Ramadan until it ended, the Prophet ﷺ recited the Quran to Jibril.

label: Night charity (hidden sadaqah)
exp: Hidden charity — his left hand does not know what his right gives.

label: Extra long sujood with dua
exp: The closest a servant is to Allah is in sujood.

label: Personal dua list — recited with conviction
exp: Prepare your requests for these blessed nights.

label: I'tikaf (even partial)
exp: The Prophet ﷺ used to observe I'tikaf in the last ten days of Ramadan.

label: No lying
exp: Allah has no need of someone giving up food and drink if they do not give up false speech and acting on it.

label: No backbiting (gheebah)
exp: Like eating the flesh of your dead brother.

label: No showing off (riya)
exp: Deeds done for show are rejected.

label: No excessive social media
exp: The believers turn away from ill speech.

label: No useless scrolling
exp: Many people lose out on two blessings: health and free time.

label: No haram or inappropriate content
exp: The hearing, sight and heart will all be questioned.

label: No overeating at iftar
exp: A few bites are enough; if you must eat more, a third for food, a third for drink, a third for breath.

label: No wasting food
exp: Allah does not love the wasteful.

label: No neglecting prayers
exp: There came successors who neglected prayer and pursued desires.

label: "Who among you is fasting today?" — I am.
"Who attended a funeral?" — I did.
exp: Following a funeral and joining its janazah prayer.

label: "Who fed a poor person?" — I did.
exp: Even a small meal or date counts.

label: "Who visited a sick person?" — I did.
exp: Visiting someone who is ill.
